metadata.title: मोदी-हिमंता का हग्रामा प्रेम  | Hagrama Mohilary: Courtesy or Calculated Politics by MODI - Himanta
metadata.description: BPF chief Hagrama Mohilary has returned to power as the Chief Executive Member (CEM) of the Bodoland Territorial Council after a strong comeback — his party won 28 of the 40 seats. Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated him, and Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma personally attended the swearing-in ceremony. But was this warm gesture from the BJP leadership merely a mark of political courtesy, or does it signal something deeper in Assam’s shifting political landscape? Our editor Shyam Sunder decodes the message behind this show of goodwill and what it could mean for the future of Bodo politics.
